en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.138 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"There is no ablution required in the instance of taenia worms (or ticks and small worms), they are regarded like lice, and this applies if they do not have any waste matter,
However, if there is waste matter, then istinja (cleansing of the private parts) and ablution are required.”
